{"template":"triangle_angle_sum","groupLabel":"Triangle angle sum","representation":"diagram","illustration":null,"steps":[{"id":"s1","reveal":"outline","narration":"Two angles are known; let’s find the missing one.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"a","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"polygon","points":[[150,450],[450,450],[300,150]],"closed":true,"fill":false}},{"op":"add","id":"b","color":"red","spec":{"kind":"angle","vertex":[150,450],"from":[450,450],"to":[300,150],"label":"42°","radius":45}},{"op":"add","id":"c","color":"green","spec":{"kind":"angle","vertex":[450,450],"from":[300,150],"to":[150,450],"label":"68°","radius":45}},{"op":"add","id":"d","color":"ink","spec":{"kind":"angle","vertex":[300,150],"from":[150,450],"to":[450,450],"label":"?","radius":42}},{"op":"add","id":"e","color":"ink","spec":{"kind":"equation","at":[620,180],"latex":"42^\\circ+68^\\circ+?=180^\\circ","size":"normal"}}]},{"id":"s2","reveal":"relation","narration":"First add the two known angles.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"f","color":"ink","spec":{"kind":"equation","at":[620,300],"latex":"42^\\circ+68^\\circ=110^\\circ","size":"normal"}}]},{"id":"s3","reveal":"emphasis","narration":"The missing angle is 70 degrees.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"g","color":"violet","spec":{"kind":"equation","at":[620,420],"latex":"180^\\circ-110^\\circ=70^\\circ","size":"normal"}},{"op":"add","id":"h","color":"violet","spec":{"kind":"text","at":[300,105],"text":"70°","size":"normal","align":"middle","style":null}}]}]}
judgeReasons: The triangle clearly shows the requested 42° and 68° angles and correctly derives the missing angle as 70° using the 180° triangle-angle sum.
The reveal order is coherent: known angles and unknown are introduced, their sum is calculated as 110°, and the final subtraction yields 70°.
Labels, equations, and colored angle markings are readable, correctly placed, and unobstructed.
The layout is clean with ample separation between the triangle and calculation steps, and the scene uses appropriate visual complexity for the goal.

judgeReasons: The storyboard narration contains a major semantic error: 2/3 is greater than 3/5, so 3/5 does not reach farther.

Labels and amounts are legible and clearly attached to the corresponding bars.

The simple bar chart is efficient for showing the three budget parts and their sum.

The scale-factor equation and final calculation are visually overlapped and difficult to read, especially in the second and third reveals.
The final orange calculation annotation collides with the highlighted box, reducing clarity and polish.
The reveal order remains generally understandable, but the cluttered overlays weaken the instructional progression.

trial.proposalText: {"template":"comparison","groupLabel":"Opportunity cost","representation":"diagram","illustration":null,"steps":[{"id":"s1","reveal":"outline","narration":"Imagine choosing between studying and going to a concert.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"b1","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[100,180],"w":220,"h":120,"text":"Study\nPrepare for the test"}},{"op":"add","id":"b2","color":"violet","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[400,180],"w":220,"h":120,"text":"Concert\nEnjoy live music"}}]},{"id":"s2","reveal":"relation","narration":"Choosing one means giving up the other option.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"c1","color":"amber","spec":{"kind":"connector","from":[320,240],"to":[400,240],"label":"choose one","dash":true}}]},{"id":"s3","reveal":"emphasis","narration":"Opportunity cost is the benefit of the next-best choice you give up.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"l1","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"label","target":"b1","side":"above","text":"chosen benefit"}},{"op":"add","id":"l2","color":"violet","spec":{"kind":"label","target":"b2","side":"above","text":"next-best forgone benefit"}},{"op":"add","id":"t1","color":"ink","spec":{"kind":"text","at":[650,200],"text":"Chosen benefit: studying helps you prepare.","size":"normal","align":"start","style":null}},{"op":"add","id":"t2","color":"ink","spec":{"kind":"text","at":[650,320],"text":"Opportunity cost: concert enjoyment given up.","size":"normal","align":"start","style":null}}]}]}
judgeReasons: The final reveal conveys the basic idea that studying has a chosen benefit and the concert is the forgone opportunity cost.
The study box and much of the explanatory text are clipped at the left and right edges, making labels and the definition difficult to read.
The 'choose one' arrow is placed beneath the concert box and does not clearly show a relationship between the two alternatives.
The reveal sequence is only partially coherent because the relation reveal does not visibly connect studying and concert choices, and the final explanatory text is truncated.
The scene is visually sparse, but the limited layout and incomplete overlays reduce its instructional effectiveness.

trial.proposalText: {"template":"comparison","groupLabel":"Opportunity cost","representation":"diagram","illustration":null,"steps":[{"id":"s1","reveal":"outline","narration":"We choose one activity, while another valuable activity is left behind.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"b1","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[100,120],"w":300,"h":100,"text":"Chosen activity: studying"}},{"op":"add","id":"b2","color":"violet","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[500,120],"w":300,"h":100,"text":"Next-best option: concert"}}]},{"id":"s2","reveal":"relation","narration":"Studying gives learning, but the concert enjoyment is the benefit we give up.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"b3","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[100,340],"w":300,"h":100,"text":"Chosen benefit: learning"}},{"op":"add","id":"b4","color":"red","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[500,340],"w":300,"h":100,"text":"Forgone benefit: concert enjoyment"}},{"op":"add","id":"c1","color":"blue","spec":{"kind":"connector","from":[250,220],"to":[250,340],"label":null,"dash":null}},{"op":"add","id":"c2","color":"red","spec":{"kind":"connector","from":[650,220],"to":[650,340],"label":null,"dash":null}}]},{"id":"s3","reveal":"emphasis","narration":"Opportunity cost means the next-best benefit we forgo: concert enjoyment.","ops":[{"op":"add","id":"b5","color":"amber","spec":{"kind":"box","at":[520,475],"w":280,"h":45,"text":"Opportunity cost: concert enjoyment"}}]}]}
judgeReasons: The core idea is semantically correct: studying is chosen, learning is gained, and concert enjoyment is identified as the forgone next-best benefit.
Several labels are visibly clipped on the left edge, reducing readability and making the first activity and benefit harder to parse.
The arrows and boxes establish the intended relationships, but the off-canvas placement is a layout defect.
The cumulative reveals remain understandable and add the opportunity-cost emphasis in a coherent order.
The scene is visually simple and focused, though the labeling should be repositioned within the canvas.

The arrows communicate that need shapes equity and fairness can guide both equality and equity, matching the requested relationship.
The labels and emphasis text are readable, and the objects are well separated without collisions or clipping.
The reveal order is coherent, though the final emphasis does not explicitly state both parts of the narration: that same is not always fair and fair is not always the same.
